opening.argument: The offer begins by directing viewers to make payment for a package that supposedly includes mining, while assuring them that whatever happens they will profit from OneCoin. It then presents passive income from recommending others and a compensation structure tied to business volume on a weaker leg. Matching bonuses paid through four generations of referrals reinforce that earnings depend on introducing people into the network. The promise of building a large pool of coins that will grow in value over time adds an easy-wealth framing to the paid package and referral incentives. Taken together, these are not merely descriptions of a product; they are claims that payment, recruitment, and continued network growth can produce returns, with the profit assurance doing the strongest persuasive work.
